overview_description.description: Zuvees offers online flower and gifting services focused on handcrafted arrangements and curated gift combinations. The company provides flower bouquets, floral boxes, cakes, chocolates, perfumes, and hampers that customers can mix and match for occasions such as birthdays, anniversaries, romance, congratulations, and get well wishes. Zuvees supports same-day and express delivery across multiple Emirates and allows customers to approve orders via video before dispatch. The service targets local and international customers sending gifts within the UAE and emphasizes fresh, imported flowers and organized order handling through its e-commerce platform.
